decisions.reason: The existing message-305 MODIFY already expands ticket allocation to mints with no referral code or an invalid referral code; random selection of an existing NFT holder remains unchanged.

The existing message-305 MODIFY already expands commission allocation to mints with no referral code or an invalid referral code; the amount and random existing-holder recipient rule remain unchanged.
The existing message-305 MODIFY already limits the code-used commission trigger to successful mints using a valid referral code; no other commission attribute is changed.
The existing message-305 MODIFY already limits code-used ticket issuance to successful primary mints using a valid referral code; ticket quantity and recipient remain unchanged.
Message 305 specifies referral-validation popup text, not FAQ content, so it does not necessarily revise the FAQ.
The reference to a $500 prize-draw ticket describes the existing Small Block reward and does not change the prize amount, draw trigger, eligibility window, or funding rules.
The source targets the referral-validation popup and does not require corresponding changes to the About page copy.
Random allocation to an existing NFT holder when a referral code is absent or invalid is not a change to prize-draw winner selection through Chainlink VRF.
Restricting valid referral codes to already minted NFTs and revising popup text does not change the metadata fields or their displayed values.
The source changes validation feedback and allocation conditions but does not change ticket counters, dashboard display, or ticket association semantics.
Message 305 is explicitly about referral-validation popup messaging and does not necessarily revise landing-page mechanics copy.
The validity restriction does not alter the identity rule that an NFT's mint number is its permanent referral code, its sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
